alkylation_reagent.evidence: UltraLink Iodoacetyl Resin (iodoacetyl-beads) were washed twice using 50mM Tris buffer before being mixed with the peptides/proteins at a ratio of 200µl beads to 1 mg peptide/proteins and rotated at room temperature overnight (protected from light).

cleavage_agent.evidence: While for the protein enrichment, the beads were washed by 50mM Tris buffer and HEPES 100 (20mM HEPES, 5mM MgCl2, 100mM NaCl) then followed by trypsin digestion.

enrichment_method.evidence: experiment types: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

labeling.evidence: lysine and arginine SILAC label were set as variable modifications and up to two missed cleavages were allowed for trypsin digestion.

ptm.evidence: Serine, threonine and tyrosine phosphorylation, methionine oxidation, lysine and arginine SILAC label were set as variable modifications and up to two missed cleavages were allowed for trypsin digestion.
